ESCALATED 2026-11-04 (blocked outside the reviewer's control; recorded, not waived). The branch is pushed (origin/feature/bp-045 = 19f248c) and two pull requests have been opened against main (PR #6 stale at f599db0, superseded by PR #7 at 19f248c), yet GitHub reports zero check-runs and zero statuses for the commit: `gh run list --branch feature/bp-045` is empty and `gh pr checks 7` reports no checks. This is not a workflow defect: .github/workflows/ci.yml is byte-identical to main (`git diff origin/main HEAD -- .github/workflows/` is empty), `pull_request:` carries no branch filter, the workflow is `state: active`, and five CI runs succeeded on 2026-11-03 including `pull_request` events on unrelated branches (e.g. run 41669121486). The blocker is account permission: the reviewing account (kenule500) holds admin:false and maintain:false on a repository owned by a different user account (Ghaythhezami), so the Actions policy endpoint returns HTTP 403, and ci.yml defines no `workflow_dispatch` (a manual dispatch returns HTTP 422), leaving no supported way to start a run. Recent green runs on main and other branches are not evidence for 19f248c. No green run exists, so this criterion stays unverified until the repository owner either permits the run or explicitly accepts the substitution of local evidence (lint, typecheck, test, build all exit 0 on 19f248c).
node .sdrive/scripts/check-permission.js slash /sdrive:review allowed the review (kenule500, admin).

Two acceptable resolutions, either of which closes this criterion: (a) a reviewer other than kenule500 records the verdict, or (b) the repository owner (Ghaythhezami) explicitly accepts the self-review, as was accepted for api-skeleton-and-ci and recorded in this feature's review.md header. Until one of these is granted this stays warn and PASS must not be written. This is a request for a yes/no answer, not a waiver claimed by the reviewer.
